scope: Consumed-data engineering replay; not prospective source generalization.
routing_rule: one escalation on malformed structured output or explicit host incumbent correction; shared model-call budget; no transport retries
prompt: Select one RISC-V custom instruction, or the unchanged baseline. Maximize VERIFIED FEASIBLE whole-program speedup within the measurement-attempt budget. Predictions are uncalibrated, not measurements. Consider all provided heuristics, structure, uncertainty, area, timing and measurement cost. Use only list_candidates, predict, measure and finalize. Every submitted measure request, including an invalid ID or repeat, consumes an attempt; failed measurements also count. No unqueried outcome is available. Only the current incumbent may be finalized: use incumbent.candidate_id exactly, or use null only when incumbent.candidate_id is null. The host computes the best paid, correct, device-fitting, area/timing-feasible improvement; never finalize a stale, unmeasured, infeasible, or lower-speedup candidate. You may stop early. The summary you submit is an unverified agent note; the host returns the authoritative measured result. Provide a short decision summary, not private chain of thought. Single instructions only; individual speedups and area cannot be added. This is consumed-data replay, not fresh hardware measurement or an unseen-workload experiment.

tools.name: list_candidates
tools.description: List public candidates and selection constraints.

tools.name: predict
tools.description: Query fixed predictors for candidate IDs.

tools.name: measure
tools.description: Pay for one candidate measurement, including failures.

tools.name: finalize
tools.description: Finalize only the current host-computed incumbent.candidate_id; use null only when no measured feasible improvement exists.

fallback: best paid verified feasible improvement, else baseline
invalid_measurements: Every submitted measure, including invalid IDs/repeats, charges before lookup while budget remains.
historical_cost_note: All historical available attempts are charged, including failed/excluded rows. Setup/calibration separate.
timer_note: Target durations are archived record/ledger durations, not live search time; these scopes differ and overlap with command timing.
isolation: External Responses model has only serialized allowlisted JSON and four strict functions; no shell, files, MCP or oracle; optional retrieval only from approved public history.
